# Packages installed on top of Omarchy. Generated by tools/sync; installed by ./install packages.
ansible                      # Official assortment of Ansible collections
clang                        # C language family frontend for LLVM
composer                     # Dependency Manager for PHP
flea                         # Fast, keyboard-first file manager for Omarchy
fuzzel                       # Application launcher for wlroots based Wayland compositors
ghostty                      # Fast, native, feature-rich terminal emulator pushing modern features
aur:google-cloud-cli         # A core set of command-line tools for the Google Cloud Platform. Includes only gcloud core (with beta and alpha commands), gcloud-crc32c and man pages
intel-compute-runtime        # Intel(R) Graphics Compute Runtime for oneAPI Level Zero and OpenCL(TM) Driver
kdenlive                     # A non-linear video editor for Linux using the MLT video framework
lazydocker                   # A simple terminal UI for docker and docker-compose, written in Go with the gocui library.
level-zero-loader            # API for accessing low level interfaces in oneAPI platform devices (loader)
llvm                         # Compiler infrastructure
obs-studio                   # Free, open source software for live streaming and recording
owe-lockfeed                 # Lock screen video feed module for the OWE wallpaper engine
python-pillow                # Python Imaging Library (PIL) fork
rbw                          # Unofficial Bitwarden CLI
tpm2-tools                   # Trusted Platform Module 2.0 tools based on tpm2-tss
xournalpp                    # Handwriting notetaking software with PDF annotation support
